# Sagar Luitel — Full Stack Web Developer & UI/UX Designer

> Portfolio and professional website of Sagar Luitel

## About

Sagar Luitel is a full stack web developer and UI/UX designer based in Pokhara, Nepal. He specializes in building fast, fluid, production-ready web experiences using React, Next.js, Three.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and GSAP animations. With expertise spanning frontend development, backend engineering, database architecture, 3D web graphics, and UI/UX design, Sagar delivers complete digital product solutions for clients in Nepal and worldwide.
